OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run python - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

t = np.loadtxt('data/pilot.csv', delimiter=',', skiprows=1)
X, y = t[:, :-1], t[:, -1]

print("univariate AUC per feature (|AUC-0.5| orientation-free):")
for j in range(X.shape[1]):
    a1 = roc_auc_score(y, X[:, j])
    a2 = roc_auc_score(y, -X[:, j])
    print(f"  x{j+1:>2}: auc {a1:.3f}  (best orientation {max(a1,a2):.3f})")

C = np.corrcoef(X.T)
off = C[np.triu_indices(12, 1)]
print(f"\ninter-feature |corr|: max {np.abs(off).max():.3f}, mean {np.abs(off).mean():.3f}")
big = [(i+1,j+1,round(C[i,j],2)) for i in range(12) for j in range(i+1,12) if abs(C[i,j])>0.6]
print("pairs with |corr|>0.6:", big if big else "none")

# how much of x-space is already unit-scale?
print("\nfeature std:", np.round(X.std(axis=0), 3))
print("feature mean:", np.round(X.mean(axis=0), 3))
